content.description: The key inline, ASCII-armored (`-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----`).

keep.description:
Keep the keyring in the final rootfs. When `false` (the default) it is removed after
provisioning and before assemble, and whatever was at that path before is put back.

name.description:
File name stem for the keyring, and what a repository's `signed_by` names. Letters,
digits, `_`, `-` and `.` only, unique within `keyrings`.

path.description:
Path to a key file on the host (ASCII-armored or binary). Relative paths are
resolved against the profile's directory.

sha256.description:
Expected SHA-256 of the key's bytes, as 64 hex digits. Checked before anything is
written; recommended with `url`, where the bytes are the server's to choose.

url.description: `https` URL to download the key from while the prepare phase runs.

explanation.description: `Explanation`: a one-line comment for the stanza.

packages.description:
`Package`: package names, glob patterns, `/regex/`, or `src:` names; `*` for every
package.

pin.description:
`Pin`: what the priority applies to, starting with `release`, `origin` or `version`
(e.g. `release n=trixie-backports`, `origin "download.docker.com"`, `version 5.8*`).

priority.description: `Pin-Priority`. Must not be zero: apt ignores a pin with priority 0.

AptPreference.description: One APT preferences file, holding one stanza per pin.

keep.description:
Keep the preferences file in the final rootfs. When `false` (the default) it is
removed after provisioning and before assemble, and whatever was at that path before
is put back.

name.description:
File name stem for the preferences file. Letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.` only (what
apt reads from `preferences.d`), unique within `preferences`.

pins.description: The pins, written as stanzas in this order.

AptRepository.description: One APT repository, rendered as a deb822 `.sources` file.

architectures.description:
deb822 `Architectures`. Omitted from the file when empty, so apt uses its
configured architectures.

components.description: deb822 `Components`. Required unless every suite is an exact path.

keep.description:
Keep the repository in the final rootfs. When `false` (the default) its file is
removed after provisioning and before assemble, and whatever was at that path before
is put back. A kept repository's keyring must be kept too.

name.description:
File name stem for the `.sources` file. Letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.` only (what
apt reads from `sources.list.d`), unique within `repositories`.

signed_by.description:
Name of an entry in `keyrings` to write as this repository's `Signed-By`. Without
it, apt verifies against the keys it already trusts.

suites.description:
deb822 `Suites`. A suite ending in `/` is an exact path, which takes no
`components`.

AptTask.description:
apt task declaring keyrings, APT repositories and APT preferences for the prepare phase.

At most one `AptTask` may appear in the prepare phase.

keyrings.description:
OpenPGP keyrings to install. Each one is written to `/etc/apt/keyrings/<name>.asc`
(ASCII-armored) or `<name>.gpg` (binary); `/etc/apt/keyrings` is created if the
rootfs has none. A repository uses one by naming it in `signed_by`.

preferences.description:
APT preferences to apply before provisioning. Each one is written to
`/etc/apt/preferences.d/<name>.pref` (see apt_preferences(5)).

repositories.description:
APT repositories to configure before provisioning. Each one is written to
`/etc/apt/sources.list.d/<name>.sources` in deb822 format.

AssembleConfig.description:
Assemble phase configuration (named-field, schema-first).

Each field is an optional singleton; a duplicate YAML key is rejected by `yaml_serde` at
parse time and an unknown key by `deny_unknown_fields`.

output.description: Build artifacts written into `dir` after the rootfs is final.

resolv_conf.description: resolv_conf task writing a permanent `/etc/resolv.conf` into the final rootfs.

AssembleResolvConfTask.description:
Assemble phase resolv_conf task for writing a permanent `/etc/resolv.conf`.

Supports two mutually exclusive modes:
- **generate**: writes a resolv.conf file from `name_servers` and `search`
- **link**: creates a symlink to the specified target path

At most one `AssembleResolvConfTask` may appear in the assemble phase.

name_servers.description: Nameserver IP addresses to write to resolv.conf.

search.description: Search domains to write to resolv.conf.

BootFileOutput.description: A file copied out of the rootfs, such as the kernel or the initramfs.

file.description: Name of the file to write in `dir` (a plain file name, not a path).

source.description:
Absolute path inside the rootfs to copy from. Symlinks are followed, confined to the
rootfs. When omitted, the kernel is looked up at `/vmlinuz` then `/boot/vmlinuz`, and
the initramfs at `/initrd.img` then `/boot/initrd.img` -- the links Debian's kernel
packages maintain to the newest installed version.

Bootstrap.description:
Bootstrap backend configuration.

This enum represents the different bootstrap tools that can be used.
The `type` field in YAML determines which variant is used.

mirrors.description: APT mirror URLs to use as package sources

mirror.description: APT mirror URL to use as package source

print_debs.description: Print packages to be installed and exit

target.description: Target output directory path (relative to profile dir)

DebootstrapVariant.description: Variant defines the package selection strategy for debootstrap

Defaults.description:
Default settings that apply across the profile.

Groups configuration defaults like isolation backend.
If omitted in YAML, all fields use their respective defaults.

isolation.description: Isolation backend for running commands in rootfs (default: chroot)

oneOf.description: Auto detect based on file extension (default)

IsolationConfig.description:
Isolation backend configuration.

The `type` key selects the backend used to run commands inside the rootfs; `chroot` is
currently the only backend. `type` is required whenever an `isolation` map is written
out — the chroot default applies only when the surrounding `isolation` key (e.g.
`defaults.isolation`) is omitted entirely.

oneOf.description: Run commands inside the rootfs via `chroot`.

MitamaeDefaults.description:
Default settings for mitamae tasks.

Allows specifying architecture-specific binary paths that apply to all
mitamae tasks unless overridden at the task level.

MmdebstrapVariant.description: Variant defines the package selection strategy for mmdebstrap

oneOf.description: The `required` set plus all packages with `Priority:important` (default)

Installs nothing by default (not even `Essential:yes` packages)
This variant is used for minimal setups where no preselected packages are required

Installs nothing by default (not even `Essential:yes` packages)
This variant allows for fully custom package selection strategies defined by the user
The `essential` set plus all packages with `Priority:required`
The `essential` set plus all packages with `Priority:required`
The `required` set plus all packages with `Priority:important`
The `important` set plus all packages with `Priority:standard`

MountEntry.description: A single mount entry specifying what to mount into the rootfs.

target.description: Mount point inside the rootfs (absolute path).

MountPreset.description: Mount preset defining a predefined set of mount entries.

oneOf.description: Recommended mount set for typical Debian rootfs operations.

MountTask.description:
Mount task for declaring filesystem mounts in the prepare phase.

This task declares which filesystems should be mounted into the rootfs
before provisioning tasks run. The actual mount/unmount lifecycle is
managed at the pipeline level, not by the task's `execute()` method.

At most one `MountTask` may appear in the prepare phase.

preset.description: Optional preset for predefined mount sets.

OutputConfig.description:
Build artifacts to write into `dir` once the rootfs is final.

Each is written under its own name directly in `dir`, next to the bootstrap target, and
replaces an existing file of that name atomically. They are written in the order
`kernel`, `initramfs`, `rootfs`, after every other assemble task.

initramfs.description: Copy the initramfs image out of the rootfs.

kernel.description: Copy the kernel image out of the rootfs.

rootfs.description: Pack the rootfs into a squashfs image with `mksquashfs`.

PrepareConfig.description:
Prepare phase configuration (named-field, schema-first).

Every field is an optional singleton. A duplicate YAML key (e.g. two `mount`
entries) is rejected by `yaml_serde` at parse time, and an unknown key is
rejected by `deny_unknown_fields` — so the "at most one" invariants hold
structurally instead of being validated after parsing.

apt.description: apt task declaring APT repositories, their keys and preferences for provisioning.

mount.description: Mount task declaring filesystem mounts for the rootfs.

resolv_conf.description: resolv_conf task declaring DNS configuration for the chroot.

PrivilegeConfig.description: Explicit privilege escalation configuration for a task or bootstrap backend.

method.description: The privilege escalation method to use.

PrivilegeDefaults.description: Default privilege settings for the profile.

ProvisionTask.description:
Declarative task definition for provision pipeline steps.

Each variant holds the data needed to configure and execute a specific
type of task. The enum dispatch pattern provides compile-time exhaustive
matching — adding a new variant causes compilation errors at every
unhandled match site, preventing missed implementations.

ResolvConfTask.description:
resolv_conf task for declaring DNS configuration in the prepare phase.

This task declares how resolv.conf should be set up inside the rootfs
before provisioning tasks run. The actual setup/teardown lifecycle is
managed at the pipeline level, not by the task's `execute()` method.

At most one `ResolvConfTask` may appear in the prepare phase.

copy.description: Copy host's /etc/resolv.conf into the chroot (following symlinks).

name_servers.description: Nameserver IP addresses to write to resolv.conf.

search.description: Search domains to write to resolv.conf.

SquashfsOutput.description: The rootfs packed into a squashfs image.

compression.description:
Compression algorithm passed to `mksquashfs -comp`. When omitted, `mksquashfs`
uses its own default (gzip).

file.description: Name of the image to write in `dir` (a plain file name, not a path).

description:
Represents a bootstrap profile configuration.

A profile contains the target directory and bootstrap tool configuration
details needed to create a Debian-based system.

assemble.description: Assemble tasks to run after provisioning (optional)

dir.description: Target directory path for the bootstrap operation

prepare.description: Prepare tasks to run before provisioning (optional)

title: Profile
